o1: Enables microtubule binding activity. Involved in ciliary body morphogenesis; gonad development; microtubule bundle formation involved in mitotic spindle midzone assembly; cytokinesis; spindle midzone organization; and spindle midzone assembly. Is located in microtubule; mitotic spindle midzone; and nucleus. Orthologous to human PRC1 (protein regulator of cytokinesis 1).
